kpis.sub: TESLA: Q3 STORAGE 13.7 GWh; SHARES ~$391 (NOV 4) AFTER SLIDING FROM ~$400
kpis.label: Q3 deployments of 13.7 GWh (vs ~15.9 GWh expected; 36.0 GWh YTD) came with energy revenue of $2.88B, down 16% y/y, and a 33.1% gross margin lifted by a one-time $526M tariff refund; the Houston-area Megafactory began production in Q3 and Megapack 3 started in September. Shares closed $391.09 on Nov 4 (~$1.55T; 50-day MA $371, 200-day MA $385), down from $399.81 on Oct 30

kpis.sub: FLUENCE: CEO AND CFO REPLACED NOV 2; STOCK STILL NEAR 52-WEEK LOW

kpis.sub: GE VERNOVA: SHARES -10.5% ON NOV 4 TO $822, THEN $774 BY NOV 6 CLOSE
kpis.label: GEV closed $774.11 on Nov 6 (market cap ~$205B; 52-week range $530.16–$1,195.94) after falling to $822.18 on Nov 4 (MarketBeat; Motley Fool cites analyst target cuts and the partly debt-funded $9B Trench deal amid AI-power financing fears). kpis.sub: US UTILITY-SCALE BATTERIES: ~14 GW MORE PLANNED IN H2 2026
kpis.label: EIA shows nearly 52 GW of US battery nameplate capacity by mid-2026 (43.6 GW at end-2025, +8.3 GW in H1), about 70% average annual growth over three years, and ~54 GW planned over the next 2.5 years (14 GW H2 2026, 26 GW 2027, 14 GW 2028) — operator-reported plans, so actuals may differ; Q2 2026 US storage installs hit a record 20.2 GWh (Mercom)

bear_case.title: China dominates cells — and scale isn't translating into easy profit
bear_case.description: CATL's Q3 revenue rose 58.6% to 165.2B yuan on 260+ GWh shipped (about a quarter to energy storage), yet net profit grew only 14.5% — its weakest in nearly two years — with gross margin at 20.69%; JPMorgan downgraded the Hong Kong shares to Neutral. Volume leadership plus price competition keeps pressure on Western integrators who buy or compete on the same cells, even as China's battery export tax rebate falls to zero on Jan 1, 2027.

bear_case.title: Tariff policy whiplash and FEOC rules cloud project economics
bear_case.description: Section 301 duties on Chinese-origin ESS batteries rose from 40.9% in 2025 to 58.4% in 2026, and FEOC content thresholds still risk disqualifying projects from the ITC. Meanwhile the February 2026 invalidation of certain IEEPA tariffs produced refunds that distorted Tesla's Q3 energy numbers ($526M cost benefit, $339M revenue reduction) — a reminder that policy swings can flatter or hurt reported margins by hundreds of millions.

bear_case.title: Margin quality at the leader is weaker than the headline
bear_case.description: Tesla's 33.1% energy gross margin leaned on a one-time $526M tariff refund; energy revenue fell 16% y/y, average Megapack prices were lower, and energy gross profit declined to $954M from $1.07B. Fluence swapped its CEO and CFO after a guide cut, SEC probe and class actions, and Eos still posts a -53% GAAP gross margin while burning ~$262M of operating cash in nine months — execution risk across US manufacturing ramps.

bear_case.title: Solid-state timelines stay long and small-cap balance sheets are fragile
bear_case.description: QuantumScape's new 100 MWh solid-state line is reportedly a 2028 event with no meaningful revenue until the 2027 PowerCo launch, while CATL and BYD still target 2027 solid-state trials. Stem is under an NYSE noncompliance notice, a ~$24–29M market cap, a strategic-alternatives headline and a delayed earnings date; Energy Vault sits near its 52-week low — financing and dilution risk is the binding constraint for the small-cap tier. AI-power names also sold off on financing fears (GEV, Bloom) in early November.
